chapter_title: Chương 143: Trần tổng chưa ra tay, Tạ Xấu Xí đã đập chết kẻ thù.

segments.title: Chương 143: Trần tổng chưa ra tay, Tạ Xấu Xí đã đập chết kẻ thù.
segments.content:
"Take a look."

Bian Guanyue stood at the door, handing two sheets of paper to Chen Guiliang.

Bian Guanyue had meticulously written down several dozen of the hottest internet songs of the moment.

Besides "Mouse Loves Rice," there was "Ten Thousand Reasons," "Two Butterflies," "Lilac Flower," "Song of the Pig," "Don't Say You Don't Care About My Tears"...

Damn, the download counts were easily in the millions, and a few had even surpassed the ten million mark.

The Great Elder frowned. Lü Ziqi wouldn't be spouting nonsense. He never expected Wan Feng to be such a dangerous person.

After the ships were docked, an order came down: "All personnel on board, stand by!" Everyone began to speculate that something must have happened. Before long, Tang Jing ran over, saying that General Zheng had summoned General Wang for an urgent matter. Wang Hou's heart skipped a beat. Without asking any more questions, he hurriedly followed Tang Jing off the "Tianzhu".

Chenxing's footsteps paused. She slowly turned her head. Aside from a few bare, crooked trees by the riverbank, there was only the same dark and dilapidated low-rise housing on the opposite side of the river, and the ubiquitous blanket of white snow.

She had fought a great battle with Pei Gongcuo for several days last year and lost spectacularly. At that time, she had only thought his intellect was out of the ordinary, and there was no need to feel sorry for herself for losing. But now, to lose to Rong Laiqing in the exact same way was truly a bit hurtful.

Chun Cao's face darkened. She looked pitifully at Lü Ziqi. Was this what they called shooting herself in the foot?

Although she was veiled, Chun Cao could tell from the voice that it was the Right Emissary.

Su Nan nodded and focused his mind, hoping to understand the mysteries of a shaman. But after a long while, he felt nothing unusual and looked at Fu Li in confusion. The moment he met Fu Li's eyes, Su Nan felt a surge of mental energy transmitted from her gaze, one that was not much weaker than his own.

The sounds of fighting had long since alarmed the entire inn. Worried for her father's safety, Zhou Tiaojing sat for a while before coming out. She happened to see her father being kicked into the air and cried out in alarm. She rushed forward to catch Clan Master Zhou, and seeing the blood at the corner of his mouth and his pale face, she knew he was seriously injured. She quickly took a porcelain bottle from her pocket, shook out a pill, and fed it to her father.

Before Concubine Li Jie could say "alright," Hua Mian used every ounce of her strength to break free from her grasp and bolted out of the cave like lightning. How could she? How could she tolerate a future without her memories? If she even forgot Brother Ye, what was the point of living? So at this moment, even if it cost her life, she had to escape from them.

Zhu Ziping was already checking on the old man who had been hit. Seeing that he had not sustained any fatal injuries and was fine, he took out two liang of silver and told him to rest and recover. The old man was naturally grateful beyond words. Returning now, he heard Yan Yue's words, and seeing Li Jingxi nod in agreement, he tied her white horse to the carriage, cracked the whip, and the carriage continued on its way.

Ye Huan carefully surveyed his surroundings. Apart from the platform in front with the giant statue, there was nothing else. It seemed the inheritance must be on the platform ahead. With this in mind, Ye Huan slowly walked toward the platform.

As for whether there was anything illicit on board, that was not their concern. Every department had its own jurisdiction.

And the Tarics before him obviously knew, otherwise he wouldn't have waited for him here specifically, nor would he have prepared such a place.

She hugged one of her arms tightly, protecting it firmly, terrified he would seize control of it again.

But she couldn't be bothered with all that right now. What he wanted to do had nothing to do with her, and what she wanted to do would have nothing to do with him from now on.

After the Nine Heavens Mystic Thunder descended, a torrential rain began to fall. However, the energy contained within the lightning bolt firmly protected Ye Huan within an energy shield, shielding him from the rain and preventing him from catching a cold. Ye Huan himself was unaware of all this. By the time he woke up, a week had already passed.
